bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance degradation of toxic spans detection methods (lexicons, rationale extraction, and fine-tuned language models) when trained on one platform dataset (e.g., SemEval/Civil Comments) and tested on a different platform dataset (e.g., HateXplain) to measure their vulnerability to distributional shift.

Conducting a detailed error analysis to categorize and measure 'FP-target' errors, identifying instances where models falsely predict target groups, identity terms, or proper nouns (e.g., 'republican') as being inherently part of the toxic span.
